summary.text: Brian Pacheco is the Democratic candidate for California State Assembly District 27 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Mike Murphy (R) in a race with no incumbent.
He is a member of the Fresno County Board of Supervisors, representing District 1, a seat he has held since 2015.

paragraphs.text: Brian Pacheco assumed office on the Fresno County Board of Supervisors in 2015, and his current term ends on January 4, 2027.
He won re-election to District 1 outright in the nonpartisan primaries of June 5, 2018, and June 7, 2022.
Pacheco is not running for re-election to the board in 2026 and advanced from the June 2, 2026 top-two primary for the Assembly seat.
